purpose: The ledger service processes journal entries, validates them, stores them in a database, and publishes events for consumption by other services.

components.name: ledger-core
components.evidence: ledger-core validates that debits equal credits, writes the entry to ledger-db (PostgreSQL) inside one transaction, and publishes a posted-entry event to ledger-events (Kafka) after the commit.

components.name: ledger-db (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: ledger-core processes each journal entry in one database transaction and writes the posted-entry event to ledger-events (Kafka) after the commit.

components.name: ledger-events (Kafka)
components.evidence: Consumers of the events, such as reporting and notifications, read the stream.

flows.evidence: Wallet and payment services -> ledger-core: journal entries and balance queries.
